sentences.en: Candidates whose nomination was rejected have five days to appeal.
sentences.zh: 被拒绝提名的候选人有五天时间提出上诉。

sentences.en: She won an Oscar nomination for best supporting actress.
sentences.zh: 她获得了一个奥斯卡最佳女配角提名。

sentences.en: No man received enough votes to win the nomination.
sentences.zh: 没有人获得足够的选票赢得提名。
